title: Snapshot series file (<region>/<source>.json)
description: Series of one source for every point of one region. Adapted from the Timeseries schema of the API contract (feat/ravi-api-contract): metadata is shared by the file and each point has its own series.

source.description: Source id (power, gldas, imerg, smap, viirs, modis).

aggregation.description: cell_mean: mean of the grid cells inside the point's box. nearest_cell: the cell that holds the point (POWER). window_mean: mean of the valid pixels inside the box (NDVI).

period.description: First and last published time; null when the source has no valid value.

points.description: Point id (see points.geojson) to its series. A point with no valid value is absent.

doi.description: Bare DOI (10.5067/...); null when the provider has none (POWER).

time.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Monthly products use the first day of the month; composites use the first day of the composite.

values.description: One entry per variable of the file; null means no valid value at that time.
